verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing says it can organize work "from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks" and lets users "create issues and manage projects," including from mobile. That establishes a first-party planning and tracking capability, but the pack never shows board views or columns. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of kanban board views with columns, details on moving items between columns or status workflows, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
